mapper.select:
SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, A.FINPROD_NAME text, CONCAT_WS('', A.FINPROD_ABBR , ',', A.FINPROD_NAME , ',' , A.FINPROD_ID , ',' , B.UNITVALUE_DEC , ',' , C.PUR_SPEED,',', A.CCY ,',', DATE_FORMAT(A.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') , ',' , DATE_FORMAT(A.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'), ',' , C.IS_CYCLE, ',' , A.OPERATION_TYPE, ',' , A.PROFIT_TYPE, ',' , PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID , ',' ,
C.DEAL_MODE , ',' ,
A.CALENDAR_ID , ',' ,
C.TERM_TYPE , ',' , PSP.CONTINUE_FLAG , ',' ,
A.LIQUIDATION_YESNO) object
FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PTL ON PTL.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PTLAUTH ON PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTLAUTH.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM PSP ON A.FINPROD_ID = PSP.FINPROD_ID, PRD_VAL_PARAM B,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND A.PROFIT_TYPE in
#{item, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND C.ISSUE_STATUS IN (#{ISSUE_STATUS_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, #{ISSUE_STATUS_03, jdbcType = VARCHAR})
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PTLAUTH.USER_ID = #{userName}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND DEAL.PS IN (#{PS_C20},#{PS_C5}) AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{isCancel} AND IFNULL(DEAL.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null' )

SELECT CDATE purNetValueDate, TDY_UNIT_VALUE purUnitNetValue, TDY_SHARE_AMT purDealNum, TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP purDealAmt FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND CDATE < STR_TO_DATE(#{netValueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') and not exists ( SELECT 1 FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD p WHERE p.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND p.CDATE < STR_TO_DATE(#{netValueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND p.CDATE > BOK_POSITION_PRD.CDATE )
AND CDATE = (SELECT max(CDATE) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{dealDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
LIMIT 1

select sum(t.share_amt) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t where t.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and t.trade_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{netValueDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and t.trade_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{dealDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and t.PS IN('C1','C2')

SELECT count(1) FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND C.PROFIT_TYPE <> #{SYLX_SYX} WHERE C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE} AND A.PS NOT IN (#{JYFX_CPRG},#{JYFX_CPCQDJ},#{JYFX_CPFF}) AND IFNULL(A.P_TRADE_ID, 'null') = 'null' AND A.IS_CANCEL = #{isCancel} AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT fin_trade_product.period_id id, fin_trade_product.period_id text, CONCAT_WS('', fin_trade_product.term_type , ',' , fin_trade_product.term , ',' , fin_trade_product.branch , ',' , DATE_FORMAT(fin_trade_product.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') ) object FROM fin_trade_product left JOIN fin_product ON fin_product.finprod_id = fin_trade_product.finprod_id WHERE FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.VDATE = #{vDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT CDATE,TDY_UNIT_VALUE FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=INTEGER} AND CDATE <= #{cDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY CDATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT distinct * FROM( SELECT FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.PERIOD_ID redPeriodId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.VDATE vDate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.Mdate mDate,
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.cprice_date redNetValueDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.unit_cprice redUnitNetValue, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.share_amt redDealNum, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.prin_amt redDealAmt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FEE_AMT_PAY redFeeLc, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT redTotalNetValue, trd_trade_fee_detail.fee_amt redFee, IFNULL(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FEE_AMT_UNPAY,0) - IFNULL(TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_AMT,0) redPurFeeHd, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.RED_COST redCost, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.RED_PROFIT redProfit,
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.cprice_date expireNetValueDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.unit_cprice expireUnitNetValue, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.share_amt expireDealNum, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.prin_amt expireDealAmt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.RED_COST expireCost, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.RED_PROFIT expireProfit,
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.cprice_date addReduceNetValueDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.unit_cprice addReduceUnitNetValue, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.share_amt addReduceDealNum, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.prin_amt addReduceDealAmt,
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID finprodId, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.branch branch FROM trd_product_deal INNER JOIN trd_product_deal_add ON trd_product_deal.trade_id = trd_product_deal_add.trade_id INNER JOIN trd_fin_product_deal_total ON trd_product_deal.totle_trade_id = trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id INNER JOIN fin_trade_product ON trd_product_deal.finprod_id = fin_trade_product.finprod_id and trd_product_deal.branch = fin_trade_product.branch LEFT JOIN trd_trade_fee_detail trd_trade_fee_detail ON trd_trade_fee_detail.trade_id = trd_product_deal.trade_id where trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and trd_product_deal.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
